- **Storage:** no data files were deleted, so this freed no storage. The newer snapshots most likely still use the same files, since every commit was an append. If you also want to clean up files that no snapshot uses, I can run orphan-file removal on these tables.
- **Scope:** I didn't touch anything in `prod`.
